11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager's almost perfect day has one small hole in a sandal: repair it, or complain about it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Everything has gone wonderfully for (subject). The weather is pleasant, breakfast was delicious, and (subject.he/she) has finished (subject.his/her) work early. Then (subject) notices that one sandal has developed a small hole. It is the only disappointing thing that has happened all day.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) spends the afternoon repairing it. The result is slightly crooked but comfortable. By evening (subject.he/she) has forgotten about the hole entirely.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: "This sandal has ruined my day," (subject) announces. (friend) looks at the sunshine, the beautiful beach, and the enormous basket of fruit beside them. "A terrible tragedy," (friend.he/she) agrees solemnly. (subject) begins laughing.
